checks.name: 01 canonical ERC20 metadata, empty initial supply and immutable illustrative parameters
02 authorized signed voucher mints the fixed amount and records learner plus lesson
03 repeated learner plus lesson rejects even with a fresh signed nonce
04 a used learner nonce cannot authorize a different lesson
05 unauthorized signer rejects without consuming claim state
06 caller must be the voucher learner
07 replacing the signed recipient invalidates the attestation
09 voucher signed for one contract rejects on another contract
10 wrong chain and named signing domain reject
11 hard cap rejects the next reward and rolls back nonce and lesson state
12 non-admin cannot grant or revoke the attestor role
13 admin revocation rejects old attestations and an explicitly granted replacement can sign
14 ordinary transfer moves the exact amount with zero token tax and unchanged supply
15 different learners can each claim the same lesson; no person-uniqueness claim
16 empty lessons and malformed signatures reject
17 no payable purchase surface, public mint function, receive or fallback in ABI
18 invalid constructor economics and zero authority addresses reject

toolingChecks.scope: Compiler/ABI,disconnected EIP712 signing,fixed helper API,and no EVM execution/network in this separate test process

sourceDigestSemantics: Harness SHA256 of the exact checkout source bytes read before/after the run; not original authorship, external authority or complete behavior proof.
guardCoverage: In-process throwing guards for net.Socket.connect,net.Server.listen,tls.connect,global fetch. This is not an operating-system-wide network capture.
providerAdapter: ethers BrowserProvider wraps only the owned in-process Ganache object; no injected browser-wallet provider.
optionalRuntimeFallback: Observed on Node24.18.0: optional native uWS ABI137 module unavailable; Ganache used its documented JavaScript fallback. No native installation performed.
remainingDependencyDebt: Ganache7.9.2 remains archived and contains affected-version bundled elliptic,secp256k1,pbkdf2 and other modules. These local checks do not remediate those advisories.
coverage: 18 named example checks, executed local transactions and rejected static calls; source hashes before/after. No exhaustive model, adversarial audit, verifier service, frontend, gas sponsor or production observation.
limitations: Authorized attestor claims, not proof of human understanding; attestor may issue false vouchers.
No Sybil prevention or independent uniqueness of human learners.
Attestor supports ECDSA EOAs only; no ERC1271 contract attestors.
Admin can add/remove attestors and admins; key custody and governance are unresolved.
Lesson identifiers are issuer-defined and not bound to an audited public curriculum registry.
No bridges, crosschain supply accounting, rewards valuation or public-chain deployment.
No pause mechanism, emergency recovery or per-voucher revocation; role revocation blocks that signer.
No gas sponsorship; zero transfer tax is separate from network gas fees.
OpenZeppelin is the locally inspected 4.9.6 snapshot, not a claim of latest release or dependency audit.
